page.subtitle: These computers work together as one AI system. Add a machine, then deploy models where they fit.
page.hideHowItWorks: Hide how to add a computer
page.emptyDescription: Install Toskar on another computer on your network and it will appear here automatically.

install.title: Install Toskar there
install.body: On a Mac, a Windows PC, or a Linux machine.

connect.title: Connect them
connect.body: On the same network it shows up below under {{available}}: choose {{add}}, then approve it on the other computer. For a server, or a computer you reach over SSH, use {{command}}.

share.title: Share the work
share.body: Toskar runs each part of a request on a computer that has the model and room for it. Deploy models to the new computer below.

errors.network: Allow Local Network / Firewall for Toskar on both computers, and keep Find other computers on, under Network & access below.
errors.claimFailed: Could not load pairing offer for that code

pairing.pairingWith: Pairing with <name>{{name}}</name>. On that computer, open Computers and Approve the incoming request.

nearby.title: Available to add
nearby.description: Toskar found these computers on your network.

fleet.title: Your Toskar team
fleet.moves: Work moves across this team automatically.
fleet.movesAdvanced: Work moves across this cluster automatically.
fleet.alone: This is the only computer in the team so far.

card.nearbyHint: On your network and ready to join this team.
card.diskLow: Low free space for more models
card.noModels: None yet. Deploy below or open Models.
card.noAddress: No address yet — try Find computers
card.trainingHint: Training an AI, so work goes to other computers when they have the model
card.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from this team? It stops taking work, and adding it again needs a new approval.

deploy.title: Deploy a model
deploy.description: Install a model on one computer or several at once. Toskar checks free disk before starting.
deploy.tryAnyway: Try anyway (download may fail on those computers)

join.title: Add a computer by command
join.description: For a server or any computer you reach over SSH. Run the command there, and it joins this team. No pairing code or nearby discovery needed.
join.makeHint: The command works once, for 15 minutes.

kindHints.installed: On a computer that already runs Toskar.
kindHints.install: Installs Toskar on Linux or macOS, starts it as a service, and joins.
kindHints.windows: Installs Toskar on Windows and joins. Run it in PowerShell.

join.fingerprint: The command checks that it reaches this computer: {{fingerprint}}

phone.title: Connect a device
phone.description: Use Toskar on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV, with this computer's models and chats.
phone.lanOff: Your device reaches this computer over your network, so Toskar will let devices on your network connect. Each needs its own key; apps on this computer don't.
phone.getApp: Don't have the app? <store>Get Toskar for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV</store>.
phone.manage: You can disconnect it any time in <access>API Access</access>.

steps.open: Open <store>Toskar</store> on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV, on the same network.

phone.address: Or enter this address on the device:
phone.unreachable: Local network access is still off, so the device can't reach this computer yet.
phone.http: Over plain HTTP, others on this network could see the code and the device's key.
phone.cancelled: The code was cancelled after too many wrong tries.
